sloka: मया च यद् अनुष्ठेयम् विस्रब्धेन तत् उच्यताम् ।वर्षासु इव च सुक्षेत्रे सर्वम् संपद्यते तव ॥४-७-२०॥
transliteration: mayā ca yad anuṣṭheyam visrabdhena tat ucyatām ।varṣāsu iva ca sukṣetre sarvam saṁpadyate tava ॥4-7-20॥

translations.english: 'Now tell me about my duty without any hesitation. I assure you that your desire will be fulfilled, just as seeds sown in a fertile land with timely rains bear fruit.
